notes.title: Unknown Fate is a part of Fulqrum Publisher Sale!
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone!

We are so happy to announce that the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/FulqrumPublishing/sale/publishersale2022]Fulqrum Publisher Sale[/url] just started and Unknown Fate is a part of it with an amazing discount!
[b]ALL of Fulqrum Publishing's games are discounted by up to 90% for an entire week![/b] The sale ends on October 27.

Besides, we have just launched a brand new game into Early Access, that being [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521070/The_Pegasus_Expedition/]The Pegasus Expedition[/url]. If you have not checked it out yet, now is the perfect time!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521070/The_Pegasus_Expedition/

Enjoy the sale, buy as many games as possible while they're discounted, play The Pegasus Expedition and don't forget to follow us on our [url=https://linktr.ee/fulqrumpublishing]Social Media[/url] so you never miss any important info!

notes.title: Update 1.1 is OUT NOW! - Gameplay Improvements & Level Design Changes
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25869760/7f6785b71a4d6173a932c1602c45090638a5bbdb.jpg[/img]

Hi guys,

we are still working on improving the experience of Unknown Fate and because of that we bring you new update!

[b]Here is the full changelog:[/b]

[list]
[*] Improved menu navigation (PC only).
[*] Monitor puzzle translated into Italian.
[*] Fix for second power (move).
[*] User can now select a level to play it again. This menu appear when you select "CONTINUE" in the main menu once finished the game.
[*] Improved volume for voice over.
[*] Improved enemies animations.
[*]  Imropoved enemies collision detection.
[*] Improved level design.
[*] Updated to last version of Unity. This should solve some minor and major random bugs (like crashes and things like that)
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25869760/cfd356f7340354932e9388eee788657a777c2e8d.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25869760/50d964012c4d28dd34def3569597d6b93adf2c83.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Unknown Fate is OUT NOW with a new trailer!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25869760/f54bbc7161ed237c877440a3228d1eff5da410d1.jpg[/img]

Hi guys,

Unknown Fate is officialy OUT NOW with 15 % launch discount!

Become Richard, who suddenly passes seamlessly from the real world into a surreal universe. You’ll encounter strange characters, unfamiliar artifacts and scenes resembling Richard’s former life, of which he has lost all memory.

We also prepared a new trailer to celebrate the launch of the game!

https://youtu.be/yB0ESdB9ZgM

Immerse yourself even more in the world of Unknown Fate with VR (HTC VIVE) and implemented support for eye-tracking by Tobii!

“Soon you will have all the answers to your questions. But you still have so much to see…”

notes.title: We have a release date!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25869760/77e077786d3a342f13c8cdba46639250a2984ff3.png[/img]

Hi guys,

we know that it has been a while but we finally have a release date! It is scheduled to come out on [b]6th of September this year![/b] It will be compatible with HTC VIVE so get ready for a surreal VR adventure full of twisted and mind blowing puzzles while encountering strange creatures!

notes.title: Come visit us at GAMESCOM 2018!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25869760/41580bd56b19d428a7dd9cf83c476d46d5b5afa4.jpg[/img]

Hi guys,

we will be attending Gamescom this year and we would love to see you there. We can play the game, chat and maybe take a selfie together?

We also have a lot of swag ready for you guys so don’t be a stranger :)

You can find us at Hall 10.1., booth D92!

notes.title: New trailer and screenshots
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

today, we want to share a new trailer and several new screenshots with you! The devs are working hard to deliver this mysterious action adventure in Q3 2017 for PC (including optional VR support), Xbox One and PS4.

Again, we're showing a small glimpse of the wonderful creature and strange worlds of Uknown Fate. Stay tuned for more!
